description: Prices one standalone video clip or talking video from a prompt or script and optional owned uploads, using the same pricing as the Brix36 create box. kind clip is a video clip from the prompt; kind talking is a person speaking that audio, and needs the audio upload plus a picture, a video or an existing artist. Returns the exact credits and price with draftId and quoteId, the model and the shape and length the price includes when those are part of it, and whether a price is available. A clip price may also return cameraOptions: the eligible cameras in the server's recommended order, each with its exact server-owned credits; to switch camera, price again with that modelKey and show only the new quote. Nothing is generated or charged. The prompt for a clip reads as a shot and describes its sound: the place's few sounds and their distance, the action's sounds at their beats, music only when asked for or for an advert, trailer or reel, and an ending that settles and holds to the last frame unless the last beat is a deliberate hit.

artistId.description: Optional Artist DNA ID when the video stars an existing artist or character.

aspectRatio.description: Optional output aspect ratio, equivalent to shape.

attachmentIds.description: Owned uploads: for a clip, a start picture or references; for talking, the audio plus the picture or video that will speak.

cameraPillId.description: Optional ID of a listed camera or action reference for a video clip.

draftId.description: Stable draft ID for this video. Optional when pricing; the price returns one. Reusing it with changed details reprices the same draft.

endFrameAssetId.description: Optional owned end-frame picture ID. The start picture belongs in attachmentIds.

enhancePrompt.description: Whether to apply deterministic Brix36 video script crafting (default true). When false, the prompt words pass unchanged.

generateAudio.description: Whether the clip should generate audio, when supported by the selected model.

kind.description: clip for a video clip, or talking for a person speaking uploaded audio.

lengthSeconds.description: Optional length in seconds when the chosen model offers a length setting.

mode.description: Optional exact catalogue profile identifier, equivalent to profileKey.

modelKey.description: Optional exact video model identifier when a specific engine is requested.

profileKey.description: Optional exact video profile identifier when requested.

prompt.description: What the video should show, or the script in the customer's words.

promptMode.description: Prompt mode: 'enhanced' (default) crafts a shooting script; 'exact' passes the prompt words unchanged.

rawPrompt.description: Optional verbatim flag. When true, the prompt words pass unchanged without server script crafting.

referenceFiles.description: Optional attached reference media. Up to 30 files and URLs combined. Ordered after any attachmentIds and before any referenceImageUrls; every file is required and any failed file stops quoting without charging.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download link for an attached reference file.

file_id.description: Host file identifier for an attached reference file.

mime_type.description: Declared supported image, video or audio MIME type.

referenceImageUrls.description: Optional public HTTPS reference media links. Up to 30 files and URLs combined. Ordered after any attachmentIds and referenceFiles; every link is required and any failed link stops quoting without charging.

items.description: Public HTTPS link to a supported image, video or audio file.

resolution.description: Optional exact resolution offered by the selected model profile.

shape.description: Optional shape such as 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 when the chosen model offers a shape setting.

sound.description: Optional music, effects and background for this clip.

name: studio_custom_video_quote
title: Price a custom video
